objectives.text: Reference a repository secret as ${{ secrets.NAME }} in a workflow instead of writing the credential into the file

Explain that GitHub attempts to redact registered secrets in logs but that redaction is not a permission boundary, so a workflow never prints a secret and masks other sensitive values with add-mask, and that a run triggered from a fork receives no repository secrets (GITHUB_TOKEN excepted)
Restrict the GITHUB_TOKEN with a permissions block to the least access the workflow needs
